rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
# Debian's patches change configure.ac. Its macros come from # autoconf-archive and pkgconf. autoreconf -vfi
# The patch for musl searches the library folders itself, point it at # those of the tools. if [ "$AELTRA_BUILD_FOR" = "tools" ]; then sed -i "s@paths = \['/lib', '/usr/local/lib', '/usr/lib'\]@paths = ['/tools/local/lib', '/tools/lib']@" \ Lib/ctypes/util.py fi
# --without-ensurepip only means that "make install" does not install pip. The # module is there, python3 -m venv needs it. As in Debian, it takes the wheel # of python3-pip-whl (see the recipe of python-pip). cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --enable-shared \ --enable-ipv6 \ --enable-loadable-sqlite-extensions \ --with-computed-gotos \ --without-ensurepip \ --with-wheel-pkg-dir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/python-wheels/" \ --with-system-expat \ --with-system-libmpdec \ --with-dbmliborder=gdbm \ --with-ssl-default-suites=openssl
rules.install:
for ENTRY in all libpython3.14-dev python3.14-venv; do mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$ENTRY" done
FULL_INSTALL="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/all"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
make DESTDIR="$FULL_INSTALL" install
rm -f "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/"*idle* rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14/idlelib" rm -fr "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14/turtledemo"
PYTHON3_CONFIG_DIR=$( echo "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"/lib/python3.14/config-3.14-* )
# As in Debian (PEP 668): pip installs into virtual environments only. cat > "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14/EXTERNALLY-MANAGED" << EOF [externally-managed] Error=To install Python packages system-wide, try aept install python3-xyz, where xyz is the package you are trying to install.
If you wish to install a Python package that is not part of Aeltra OS, create a virtual environment using python3 -m venv path/to/venv. Then use path/to/venv/bin/python and path/to/venv/bin/pip. Make sure you have python3.14-venv installed. EOF chmod 0644 "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14/EXTERNALLY-MANAGED"
cp "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/Tools/i18n/pygettext.py" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/pygettext3.14" mv "$PYTHON3_CONFIG_DIR/libpython3.14.a" \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" ln -sf ../../libpython3.14.a \ "$PYTHON3_CONFIG_DIR/libpython3.14.a" ln -sf ../../libpython3.14.so \ "$PYTHON3_CONFIG_DIR/libpython3.14.so" ln -sf libpython3.14.so.1.0 \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/libpython3.14.so.1" ln -sf ../lib/python3.14/pdb.py \ "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/pdb3.14"
cd "$FULL_INSTALL" find . -type d -a \( -name "test" -o -name "tests" \) -prune -exec rm -fr '{}' ';'
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/libpython3.14-dev" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"/bin/python3.14*-config \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14"/config-3.14* \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14/" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"libpython3.14*.a \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/" mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"libpython3.14*.so \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------- PKG_PATH="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3.14-venv" # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" install -d -m 0755 "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14"
# As in Debian, the wheel that comes with Python's sources is not packaged: it # is another version of pip than ours, without Debian's patches, which make pip # trust the certificates of the system, and with programs for Windows in it. rm -r "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14/ensurepip/_bundled"
mv "$FULL_INSTALL/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14/ensurepip" \ "$PKG_PATH/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3.14"
